arxiv-2011-14566.title: Parton Interpretation and Twist-4 Parton Distributions
arxiv-2011-14566.description: Abstract Through explicit examples we show that twist-4 parton distributions have no parton interpretation in the sense that parton or partons inside a hadron can carry the momentum fraction x x of the hadron with x > 1 x>1 or x < − 1 x<-1 .

arxiv-2104-13920.title: Re-entrant superconductivity through a quantum Lifshitz transition in twisted trilayer graphene
arxiv-2104-13920.creator: Ethan Lake, T. Senthil
arxiv-2104-13920.description: Abstract A series of recent experiments have demonstrated robust superconductivity in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene (TTG). In particular, a recent work by Cao et al. (arxiv:2103.12083) studies the behavior of the superconductor in an in-plane magnetic field and an out-of-plane displacement field, finding that the superconductor is unlikely to have purely spin-singlet pairing.

The complete sample consists of 102 quasars with a flux density level S 1.4 ≥ 100 S_{1.4}\geq 100 mJy in a declination range − 35 ​ ° ≤ Dec ≤ + 49 ​ ° -35°\leq{\rm Dec}\leq+49° .

arxiv-2211-12632.title: Complex-Valued Time-Frequency Self-Attention for Speech Dereverberation
arxiv-2211-12632.creator: Vinay Kothapally, John H.L. Hansen
arxiv-2211-12632.description: Abstract Several speech processing systems have demonstrated considerable performance improvements when deep complex neural networks (DCNN) are coupled with self-attention (SA) networks. However, the majority of DCNN-based studies on speech dereverberation that employ self-attention do not explicitly account for the inter-dependencies between real and imaginary features when computing attention.

arxiv-2306-15188.title: One-class systems seamlessly fit in the forward-forward algorithm
arxiv-2306-15188.creator: Michael Hopwood
arxiv-2306-15188.description: Abstract The forward-forward algorithm [ Hinton, 2022 ] presents a new method of training neural networks by updating weights during an inference, performing parameter updates for each layer individually. This immediately reduces memory requirements during training and may lead to many more benefits, like seamless online training.

arxiv-2312-12601.title: Diagonalizing the Born-Oppenheimer Hamiltonian via Moyal Perturbation Theory, Nonadiabatic Corrections and Translational Degrees of Freedom
arxiv-2312-12601.creator: Robert Littlejohn, Jonathan Rawlinson, Joseph Subotnik
arxiv-2312-12601.description: Abstract This article describes a method for calculating higher order or nonadiabatic corrections in Born-Oppenheimer theory and its interaction with the translational degrees of freedom. The method uses the Wigner-Weyl correspondence to map nuclear operators into functions on the classical phase space and the Moyal star product to represent operator multiplication on those functions.

arxiv-2403-01918.title: Towards Continuous Assurance Case Creation for ADS with the Evidential Tool Bus
arxiv-2403-01918.creator: Lev Sorokin, Radouane Bouchekir ∗, Tewodros A. Beyene ∗, Brian Hsuan-Cheng Liao, Adam Molin
arxiv-2403-01918.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Lev Sorokin, Radouane Bouchekir ∗, Tewodros A. Beyene ∗, Brian Hsuan-Cheng Liao, Adam Molin. An assurance case has become an integral component for the certification of safety-critical systems. While manually defining assurance case patterns can be not avoided, system-specific instantiations of assurance case patterns are both costly and time-consuming.

arxiv-2404-00015.title: Empowering Credit Scoring Systems with Quantum-Enhanced Machine Learning
arxiv-2404-00015.creator: Javier Mancilla, André Sequeira, Tomas Tagliani, Francisco Llaneza, Claudio Beiza
arxiv-2404-00015.description: Abstract Quantum Kernels are projected to provide early-stage usefulness for quantum machine learning. However, highly sophisticated classical models are hard to surpass without losing interpretability, particularly when vast datasets can be exploited. Nonetheless, classical models struggle once data is scarce and skewed.

arxiv-2407-11421.title: States Hidden in Hidden States: LLMs Emerge Discrete State Representations Implicitly
arxiv-2407-11421.creator: Junhao Chen, Shengding Hu, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong SunDepartment of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua UniversityBeijing, China chenjunh22@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2407-11421.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit various emergent abilities. Among these abilities, some might reveal the internal working mechanisms of models. In this paper, we uncover a novel emergent capability in models: the intrinsic ability to perform extended sequences of calculations without relying on chain-of-thought step-by-step solutions.

arxiv-2407-16055.title: Quantum Detection of Recurrent Dynamics
arxiv-2407-16055.creator: Michael H. Freedman
arxiv-2407-16055.description: Abstract . Quantum dynamics that explore an unexpectedly small fraction of Hilbert space is inherently interesting. Integrable systems, quantum scars, MBL, hidden tensor structures, and systems with gauge symmetries are examples. Beyond dimension and volume, spectral features such as an O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) -density of periodic eigenvalues, or other spectral features, can also imply observable recurrence.

arxiv-2410-19054.title: Infogent : An Agent-Based Framework for Web Information Aggregation
arxiv-2410-19054.creator: Revanth Gangi Reddy Sagnik Mukherjee Jeonghwan Kim Zhenhailong Wang
arxiv-2410-19054.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Revanth Gangi Reddy Sagnik Mukherjee Jeonghwan Kim Zhenhailong Wang. Despite seemingly performant web agents on the task-completion benchmarks, most existing methods evaluate the agents based on a presupposition: the web navigation task consists of linear sequence of actions with an end state that marks task completion. In contrast, our work focuses on web navigation for information aggregation , wherein the agent must explore different websites to gather information for a complex query.

arxiv-2504-04098.title: RIS-Empowered Integrated Location Sensing and Communication with Superimposed Pilots
arxiv-2504-04098.creator: Wenchao Xia, Ben Zhao, Wankai Tang, Yongxu Zhu, Kai-Kit Wong, Sangarapillai Lambotharan, Hyundong Shin
arxiv-2504-04098.description: Abstract In addition to enhancing wireless communication coverage quality, reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) technique can also assist in positioning. In this work, we consider RIS-assisted superimposed pilot and data transmission without the assumption availability of prior channel state information and position information of mobile user equipments (UEs).

arxiv-2509-04947.title: Note on searching for critical lattice models as entropy critical points from strange correlator
arxiv-2509-04947.creator: Anran Jin, Ling-Yan Hung
arxiv-2509-04947.description: Abstract An entropy function is proposed in Ref. Lin and McGreevy 2023 as a way to detect criticality even when the system size is small. In this note we apply this strategy in the search for criticality of lattice transfer matrices constructed based on the topological holographic principle.

arxiv-2512-23247.title: Isotope Effects and the Negative Thermal Expansion Phenomena in Ice and Water
arxiv-2512-23247.creator: B. I. Min 1, J.-S. Kang 2
arxiv-2512-23247.description: Abstract H 2 O is a unique substance with exceptional thermal properties arising from the subtle interplay between its electronic, phononic, and structural degrees of freedom. Of particular interest in H 2 O are the negative thermal expansion (NTE) phenomena, observed in its solid phase (ice) at low temperature, and in its liquid phase (water) near the freezing temperature.

pmc-10551450.title: Hepatitis C virus alters the morphology and function of peroxisomes
pmc-10551450.creator: Esther Martin de Fourchambault, Nathalie Callens, Jean-Michel Saliou, Marie Fourcot, Oceane Delos, Nicolas Barois, Quentin Thorel, Santseharay Ramirez, Jens Bukh, Laurence Cocquerel, Justine Bertrand-Michel, Guillemette Marot, Yasmine Sebti, Jean Dubuisson, Yves Rouillé
pmc-10551450.description: Despite the introduction of effective treatments for hepatitis C in clinics, issues remain regarding the liver disease induced by chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection. HCV is known to disturb the metabolism of infected cells, especially lipid metabolism and redox balance, but the mechanisms leading to HCV-induced pathogenesis are still poorly understood.

pmc-11522057.title: Assessment of nitrogen and phosphorus losses due to erosion in compost-treated and non-treated vineyard soils: effect of rainfall intensity
pmc-11522057.creator: María Concepción Ramos
pmc-11522057.description: Vineyards in Mediterranean areas suffer from significant soil degradation through erosion, due to rainfall and soil characteristics, as well as soil management practices. Previous studies pointed out the nutrient losses produced by erosion and the benefits that some management practices could have on reducing erosion.

pmc-11669035.title: Utility of Duplex Ultrasound in the Diagnosis and Treatment of Functional Popliteal Artery Entrapment Syndrome
pmc-11669035.creator: Naoya Kuriyama, Shinsuke Kikuchi, Yuki Hashimoto, Tsutomu Doita, Keisuke Kamada, Nobuyoshi Azuma
pmc-11669035.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A 19-year-old female presented with intermittent claudication without anatomical abnormality in the popliteal fossa on magnetic resonance imaging and computed tomography. However, duplex ultrasound (DUS) showed compression of the popliteal artery (PA) and vein during plantarflexion and dorsiflexion. She was diagnosed with functional PA entrapment syndrome (PAES) and underwent resection of the plantaris and gastrocnemius muscles using DUS with stress maneuvers, which relieved the symptoms. In physically active adults, functional PAES can develop without anatomical abnormality.

pmc-12607502.title: Pancreatic Cancer and Diabetes: Insights, Hypotheses, and Next Steps
pmc-12607502.creator: Jessica L E Hill, Thomas G Hill, Dominique Parslow, David J Hill, Anna Pryczynicz
pmc-12607502.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is frequently associated with new-onset diabetes (NOD) in adults aged ≥ 50 years. Accordingly, NOD may serve as an early clinical marker for PDAC, although the causal links remain incompletely defined. This review synthesises clinical and experimental evidence into an islet-centric view in which tumour-derived signals and microenvironmental changes impair β-cell insulin secretion and disrupt α- and δ-cell regulation. We distinguish findings established in PDAC from mechanisms inferred from islet physiology and systemic metabolism.

pmc-12651761.title: Facilitators and Barriers to the Implementation of Family Integrated Care in Ontario Level II Neonatal Intensive Care Units
pmc-12651761.creator: Ayah Al Bizri, Mariana Bueno, Vibhuti Shah, Fabiana Bacchini, Douglas M Campbell, Karen M Benzies, Karel O’Brien, Mina Hanna
pmc-12651761.description: Highlights What are the main findings? •CFIR was a useful framework for the identification of facilitators and barriers to implementing FICare in Ontario’s Level II NICUs.•There is variability in the readiness of Level II NICUs to implement FICare based on NICU preparedness, capacity, population served, and geographical distribution. What is the implication of the main finding?

pmc-12652269.title: The Effects of Processing Conditions and Pressure on Composite Polymer Electrolyte Performance
pmc-12652269.creator: Samantha P Macchi, Lillian N Elam, Josefine D McBrayer, Noah B Schorr, Peihua Yang
pmc-12652269.description: Solid polymer and composite polymer electrolytes have been investigated as a replacement for liquid electrolytes in lithium batteries and have shown promising conductivities at room temperature. However, the literature reports often do not fully investigate the effects of residual solvent or testing apparatus conditions, leading to discrepancies in reported performance and possible conflation of conductivity values.

pmc-12717139.title: Contrasting Life History Characteristics Between Riverine and Lacustrine Anadromous Arctic Char ( Salvelinus alpinus ) in the Western Canadian Arctic
pmc-12717139.creator: Colin P. Gallagher, Xinhua Zhu, Ellen V. Lea, Kimberly L. Howland
pmc-12717139.description: Freshwater habitat characteristics are known to affect life history traits of migratory salmonids. Although the life cycle of the anadromous form of Arctic char ( Salvelinus alpinus ) is typically associated with lakes, there is a small number of anadromous populations in North America that spawn, rear, and overwinter exclusively in rivers.

pmc-13004687.title: Estropausal gut microbiota transplant improves measures of ovarian function in adult mice
pmc-13004687.creator: Minhoo Kim, Justin Wang, Steven E Pilley, Ryan J Lu, Alan Xu, Younggyun Kim, Minying Liu, Xueyan Fu, Sarah L Booth, Peter J Mullen, Bérénice A Benayoun
pmc-13004687.description: The decline in ovarian function with age affects fertility and is associated with increased risk of age-related diseases, including osteoporosis and dementia. Notably, earlier menopause is linked to shorter lifespan, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying ovarian aging remain poorly understood. Recent evidence suggests the gut microbiota may influence ovarian health.

pmc-13283406.title: Undiagnosed and Uncontrolled Hypertension in the Aseer Region, Saudi Arabia: A Ramadan Screening Study with Long-Term Trends (1990–2019) and Projections to 2027
pmc-13283406.creator: Faisal Saeed Al-Qahtani, Safar Saad Battar, Muammar Hassan Musharraf, Ali Mohammed AlAmri, Awad Alsamghan, Ayoub Ali Alshaikh, Mozoun Dafer Alahmari, Ramy Mohamed Ghazy

pmc-13422571.title: Expedition cruises, island hopping, and zoonotic risk: governance and operational lessons from the MV Hondius Andes hantavirus outbreak
pmc-13422571.creator: Esteban Ortiz-Prado, María Paz Cadena, María A. Vethencourt-Ysea, Jorge Vasconez-Gonzalez, Kirk O. Douglas, Juan S. Izquierdo-Condoy
pmc-13422571.description: The Andes orthohantavirus outbreak linked to the MV Hondius expedition cruise illustrates how a probable land-based zoonotic exposure can become a multinational public health event when it intersects with enclosed shipboard environments, delayed clinical recognition, remote navigation, medical evacuation, and international passenger dispersal.

pmc-13424843.title: Socioeconomic factors and time to diagnosis in hidradenitis suppurativa
pmc-13424843.creator: Aileen Y Chang, Krittin J Supapannachart, John Boscardin, Jinoos Yazdany, Haley B Naik
pmc-13424843.description: Diagnostic delay is common in hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), yet the influence of socioeconomic status remains poorly understood. In this cross-sectional study of patients with HS enrolled in a single-institution longitudinal cohort, time to diagnosis was 53% shorter among patients with less than a bachelor’s degree and 73.1% longer among those living in nonmetropolitan or smaller metropolitan areas.

pmc-13552085.title: Delayed Rupture of the Extensor Pollicis Longus Tendon following Dorsal Plating of a Distal Radius Fracture in a Rheumatoid Arthritis Patient with Differing Ultrasonographic Findings: A Case Report
pmc-13552085.creator: C Abhijith, Adarsh Varghese Mathew
pmc-13552085.description: Introduction:Delayed rupture of the extensor pollicis longus (EPL) tendon is an uncommon but disabling complication following distal radius fracture fixation. The risk is increased in patients with systemic conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis and diabetes mellitus. Although ultrasonography is commonly used for diagnosis, imaging findings may not always correlate with intraoperative observations.

pmc-13633971.title: Ru3: a novel ruthenium-based compound overcomes cisplatin resistance in non-small cell lung cancer via the E2F2-IGFBP3-GPX4 pathway
pmc-13633971.creator: Yiting Lu, Shiming Wu, Ying Jiang, Meishu Wang, Xinyu Liao, Jian Zhang, Junqi Xiang, Hua Yang, Min Yu, Jiang Min, Chen Fu, Yunlong Lei
pmc-13633971.description: Cisplatin resistance remains a major hurdle in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) treatment. Here, we designed and synthesized a novel ruthenium-based compound, which selectively kills cisplatin-resistant NSCLC cells while sparing parental cells. Mechanistically, Ru3 triggers mitochondrial damage and reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation. In addition, it upregulates the transcription factor E2F2, which directly represses IGFBP3 expression.
